constraints: No API authentication or RBAC ownership change
No Root Authority or production approval change
No duplicate schema-application logic across PostgreSQL workflows
Tenant context absence must expose zero tenant rows for non-bypass runtime roles
Cross-tenant writes must be denied by PostgreSQL RLS
Existing legacy tests retain legacy tenant compatibility through migration defaults
CI PostgreSQL server and client major versions must remain compatible
Every continuation must classify same-workstream Git failures before unrelated work
Every commit must refresh latest main and exact target-file status immediately before creation
